messages:
peter: opened PR #5788 with a dashboard rollup + tracehook guidance draft. includes Scala & Kotlin snippets and a small JSON widget example. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5788
alana: thanks, will skim now. which parts need attention most?
peter: mainly SDK snippet names (i copied from older internal examples), the widget JSON keys, and a link sweep for anchors. also added a short para on latency shading for SLO owners but it felt terse.
sam: quick glance at Scala snippet: the client call uses `prefetchKV` but the current Scala SDK uses `kvPrefetch`. snippet here:
```scala
import ai.redwood._
val client = RedwoodClient(sys.env("REDWOOD_KEY"))
val entries = client.kvPrefetch("user:", 25)
println(entries.keys.take(5))
```
sam: recommend switching to the async variant and include implicit ec, like other Scala samples. i'll make a tiny patch.
geri: on the dashboard JSON, the widget uses field "cost_usd" but our dashboards expect "cost_us" (we renamed fields last quarter). that will break staging.
peter: ouch. i must have pulled an older snippet. i'll update to "cost_us" and re-run preview.
link-bot: linkcheck: broken anchor -> /docs/console/rollups#per-route-costs -> 404
link-bot: suggestion: /docs/console/rollups#per-route-costing

alana: good catch @link-bot. @peter can you update the anchor and add a short redirect note?
peter: pushing fixes: updated anchor to #per-route-costing, switched widget key to "cost_us", and replaced Scala sync call with async example. also added a slightly expanded paragraph for SLO owners about latency shading and canary rollout cadence.
sam: pushed a follow-up to modernize the Scala snippet and added implicit ExecutionContext. changed method to `kvPrefetchAsync` to match SDK.
geri: LGTM on the JSON and link fixes. i also checked the Kotlin snippet; small nit: use `suspend` function example to match idiomatic coroutine usage. i'll push that tiny tweak.
docs-bot: preview build for branch docs/pr-5788 queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/11001
docs-bot: preview build passed for branch docs/pr-5788  warnings: 1 (admonition formatting). details: https://ci.redwood.ai/11001
alana: thanks team. can someone approve? i'd like this merged before next docs cut.
sam: approved.
geri: approved.
peter: merging now. will monitor staging snapshots for widget rendering.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for docs-site (staging) -> job 11022
peter: created follow-up issue #867 to add an explicit batching vs latency mini-guide and to surface the SLO/canary checklist. will link back to this PR in the issue.
alana: nice work. will loop in performance to help with the latency shading wording.
